fact_text: MB Malik Sports, a cricket bat maker in Sialkot, was started in 1964 by the director's grandfather and is now run by the third generation of the family.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: The director named Abdullah Shafique, Azam Khan and Saim Ayub among the leading Pakistan players who use the company's bats.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: The director said the company set out to compete in international markets and that it is succeeding, with exports reaching the UK, Europe and the Middle East.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: The director said the company typically produces close to 10,000 bats a year, mainly through routine work that order volumes can push up or down.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: The director said importing the willow, paying duty and handling the shipment make the import side the biggest challenge of running the business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: Ahead of the federal budget, the director said relief for sports exports would be the most helpful measure for the industry.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: The director said the UK is the company's largest export market for its bats, followed by Europe and then the Middle East.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: The director said bats must meet international standards, including a gauge limit of 40 mm that the bats must not exceed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: Bats are customised to each player's weight and profile, because international players have their own preferred weight and balance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: Willow blades are graded from one to three, and the grade decides the marking and numbering put on each blade before it is cut for a bat.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: After the blade is sized and its face cleaned, a V-shaped mark is cut where the handle goes, and the handle is fixed with a special chemical so the blade can break without the handle coming loose.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: Pressing forms the bat's shape, which sets its punch and stroke; balance and profile are then checked, the weight is set, and the bat is finished as the last step.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)

fact_text: The company is based in Sialkot, a city the director described as known worldwide for its sports goods industry.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'MB Malik Sports: Crafting Champion-Worthy Cricket Bats Since 1960s | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-30)
